summary: billion-context is a TypeScript plugin that compresses context windows, enabling 100K+ context capacity, 5x token savings, and month-long single-session conversations with billions of tokens.
usecases: Running long-form document analysis or legal contract review in a single LLM session without context overflow.
Enabling month-long continuous chat assistants that retain full conversation history with massive token budgets.
Reducing API costs and latency for LLM applications by compressing prompts while preserving key information.
ideas: Integrate with code editors to optimize large codebase contexts for AI pair programming.
Deploy as middleware for chatbots handling long-term customer service interactions with full history retention.
Combine with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to selectively compress irrelevant tokens while preserving retrieved knowledge.
